person:jack hartung:.notes: Jack Hartung (John R. Hartung) is a highly accomplished executive whose career spans ~40 years across McDonald's and Chipotle. He joined Chipotle in 2002 as CFO, helped scale the chain from ~100 restaurants to over 3,700 internationally, and later served as President and Chief Strategy Officer. He stepped down from his executive role on June 1, 2025, transitioning to a senior advisor role through early March 2026. He was appointed to Tesla's Board of Directors effective June 1, 2025 (serving on the audit committee), and also serves on the boards of Portillo's (since Jan 2025), The Honest Company (since May 2022), and the private company Zocdoc (since Jan 2022). The Zocdoc board seat is not included in the public board seats field as it is a private company. He holds a BS in Accounting & Economics and an MBA from Illinois State University. All information is cross-verified across multiple high-quality sources including SEC filings, company IR pages, and major business media.
